Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?
The cheaper option, the Porchgate Amish Heavy Duty Ardmore Porch Swing, is more than fine - it is built to the exact same high standards!
Both models are handcrafted in Pennsylvania by Amish woodworkers using the same Grade A kiln-dried yellow pine, rust-resistant yellow zinc hardware, and 700 lb weight capacity. The extra price for the Boardwalk comes down entirely to aesthetic styling (the decorative farmhouse X-backrest) rather than structural durability or comfort.
If your main goal is getting the maximum strength and durability for your dollar, the Ardmore gives you everything you need at the lower price point.
